revision.text: {{Wireless adapter |brand=Microsoft |model=Xbox 360 Slim Wireless Module |revision=(1400) |asin= |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf=Foxconn |manuf_model=U72H003 |manuf_rev= |availability= |fcc_date=03/31/2010 |fcc_id=C3K1400, C3K1488 |ic_id=3048A-1400 |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=6-pin connector |form_factor=module |vendor_id=045e |device_id=0765 |chip1_brand=Marvell |chip1_model=88W8786U;88W8786U-NAP2, P2A7680.3, 1016 A1P, TW; |ant_conn=none |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |accessible_UART=No |addl_chips=2.4GHz Power Amplifier IC;Skyworks;SE2597L;;1;,,, SPI Flash (4Mb);Winbond;W25X40;Winbond, 25X40AVNIG, 1006;1; |flags= |oui=64:27:37, 78:E4:00 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This module is used in the Xbox 360 Slim. ===Generic info=== *Wi-Fi Chipset: [[Marvell]] 88W8786U-NAP2 *Flash: [[Winbond]] W25X40BVSNIG (4Mbit/512kB) *USB ID: [045e:0765] There are different models of this board used: *Model 1400, X850272-007, U72H003 GP, 800571 REV.0, FCC: C3K1400 *Model 1488, X858591-002, U72H003 01, Marvell B52 REV 3.0, FCC: C3K1488 The Xbox 360 Slim family (Corona/Trinity/Winchester) comes with an internal Wi-Fi module. :It is connected to the motherboard via USB protocol, it uses 3.3V VCC instead of 5V. ===Links=== *[https://free60.org/Hardware/Console/Ethernet/ ''Generic info'' on '''Free60''' wiki] *[https://forums.smallnetbuilder.com/showthread.php?p=57960 On '''SNB''' forum] *[https://forums.xbox-scene.com/index.php?showtopic=722395 USB ID: '''045e:0765'''] ==Images== __NOTOC__
